title: Quantifying the Impact of Ambulance Ramping: A Multi-Year Analysis of Victorian Emergency Medical Services Cases
abstract: arXiv:2610.00818v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Ambulance ramping, the delay between hospital arrival and patient handover, is a critical operational bottleneck in Emergency Medical Services (EMS), yet its systemic magnitude and dynamics remain inadequately characterised at scale. This paper quantifies the scale, trajectory, and operational correlates of ramping across an entire statewide EMS system, analysing 2,850,575 ambulance attendances in Victoria, Australia from January 2020 to March 2024 using an Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA). After systematic preprocessing, an analytical cohort of 2,026,569 Emergency Department (ED) transports across 59 hospitals with ED and 79 Local Government Areas (LGA) was examined through interval decomposition, Pareto concentration, hourly cross-correlation, hospital arrival concurrency and priority-stratified operational comparisons. Cumulative Ambulance Hours Lost (AHL) totalled 1,491,127 hours, equivalent to approximately 96 ten-hour ambulance shif

translated_title: 量化救护车滞留的影响：维多利亚州紧急医疗服务案例的多年期分析
translated_abstract: 救护车滞留是指救护车抵达医院与患者交接之间的延误，是紧急医疗服务（EMS）中的关键运营瓶颈，但其在整体规模上的系统性量级和动态变化仍未得到充分表征。本文对整个州级EMS系统中滞留现象的规模、演变轨迹及运营相关因素进行了量化分析，采用探索性数据分析（EDA）方法研究了2020年1月至2024年3月期间澳大利亚维多利亚州的2,850,575次救护车出诊记录。经过系统性数据预处理，研究对来自59家设有急诊科的医院和79个地方政府区域（LGA）的2,026,569次急诊科转运分析队列，通过区间分解、帕累托集中度分析、小时级交叉相关性、医院到达并发性以及按优先级分层的运营比较等方法进行了考察。累计救护车损失小时数（AHL）总计达1,491,127小时，相当于约96个十小时制救护车班次的运力损失。
tldr: 本文通过对澳大利亚维多利亚州2020至2024年间超过285万次救护车出诊数据的探索性分析，首次在全州范围内系统量化了救护车滞留问题的规模——累计损失近150万救护车小时，并揭示了这一运营瓶颈的演变轨迹及其与医院运营指标的关联。
en_tdlr: This paper presents the first statewide-scale quantification of ambulance ramping in Victoria, Australia, analyzing over 2.85 million ambulance attendances from 2020 to 2024 and revealing cumulative losses of nearly 1.5 million ambulance hours along with their operational correlates.
